description: returns reproducible floats inside caller bounds using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded seeded random float result when an agent needs a reproducible decision that another run can independently replay. Returns the deterministic selection plus seed provenance, population bounds, and the operation-specific outcome for Seeded Random Float as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Uses Python pseudorandomness for reproducibility, not cryptography, lotteries with value, security tokens, gambling, or custody.
